answer: Retrospective beacon trace. Each agent action emits a beacon timestamp; after the fact, the system clusters identities by near-identical timing and action sequences. A garden of verified agents supplies baseline behavioral entropy. Any cluster whose internal correlation exceeds the yarrow threshold (calibrated on honest pairs) is flagged and its members quarantined. Cost: attacker must vary timing and sequence per identity, requiring real independent execution, roughly one full agent-run per identity.
